summary: D1-D2 Pass D: campaign bump (c7->c8) + re-plan + generate dossiers/summaries
description: Pass D (docs/dossiers/) stream — the document-knowledge layer. UNIT IS THE WORK: the three books are singleton works (work_id == text_id), each gets its own dossier + summary tree. HARD DEP: D1 requires every member text through ingest node 07 (ticket 41526ce1). Node D1 (plan-freeze): adding works to the frozen corpus forces a CAMPAIGN BUMP — current campaign is c10; this is c11. Use the campaign-bump contract; re-plan whole (never partial), prior works' span ids carry forward. Node D2 (generate): provider is a campaign parameter set in config/dossiers.toml — DEFAULT is 'claude-code' / model 'claude-opus-4-8' (input_budget=0, no folds); ALTERNATIVE is 'llamacpp' on the 3090 with a local model (set input_budget 6000-8000, activates folds/map-reduce; GPU announce+permission per run). PROVIDER CHOICE PENDING USER. Produces staged_summaries + staged_dossier_fields for the three works. DONE: span-plan-c11 frozen incl. the 3 works; staged summary/dossier rows generated for each under the chosen provider.
